reading.body:
Endava is an AI services vendor, not an AI infrastructure owner, so its filings say nothing about the compute and power constraints that bind AI scaling.

The record is a company profile, not an operational dataset. It establishes that Endava trades on the NYSE as DAVA, files with the SEC under CIK 0001656081, and sits in computer programming services. Its self-description centers on engineering, AI-native delivery, and industry expertise, with one named offering, Dava.X, covering AI, core modernisation, and cloud. Eight filings appear between September 2025 and September 2026, all on Form 6-K, the form a foreign private issuer uses for interim disclosure.

That pattern matters for AI only indirectly. A firm selling AI adoption services scales with billable engineers and client demand, not with megawatts or floor space. Nothing here reports data center capacity, power contracts, chip supply, or capital expenditure, so the data cannot support any claim about Endava's exposure to the grid constraint. It also cannot show revenue, margins, headcount, or how much of the business is actually AI work, because no financial figures are included.

What the record does establish is positioning. Endava presents itself as helping clients adopt AI rather than building the physical layer AI runs on. The absence of listed products beyond Dava.X and the absence of any litigation or MCP servers are gaps in the record, not findings about the company.

profile_text.body:
Endava is a public company, traded as DAVA, that describes itself as combining engineering, AI-native delivery and industry expertise to help businesses "shape the future with intelligence." On its own site it says it helps customers accelerate growth, navigate complex challenges and drive success in changing markets, and that it supports clients bringing new products to life or planning how to use AI. It also says it combines data, AI and intelligent automation with creativity and other technologies to deliver technology solutions.

The site names one offering, Dava.X, which Endava describes as providing tailored expertise in areas such as AI, core modernisation and cloud, to help clients adopt technologies rapidly and at scale. No other products are listed in the available material.

The record also notes Endava's SEC filing identifier, 0001656081, and its status as a for-profit public company. No lawsuits or MCP servers are listed for it.
